description: Review of non-evaporable getter (NEG) alloys for tritium recovery: what NEGs pump (active gases only), Sieverts' constants, and the ST707 hydrogen embrittlement limit of 20 Torr.L/g. 16 pages.
attribution: Santucci, A.; Farina, L.; Tosti, S.; Frattolillo, A. Novel Non-Evaporable Getter Materials and Their Possible Use in Fusion Application for Tritium Recovery. Molecules 2020, 25, 5675. https://doi.org/10.3390/molecules25235675. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
